items.title: Nortilus week 48: product tanker spot rates rebound roughly 9–30%; one-year VLCC at $165,000/day
items.summary: Nortilus' weekly update reports product tanker spot rates recovered by roughly 9–30% over the week and crude tanker rates by about 10%. One-year VLCC time-charter rates eased to $165,000/day. Listed product tanker shares rose 1.7% on the week but are down 15.8% month to date; crude tanker shares gained 4.7%.

items.title: BIMCO: clean-product cargo volumes down 11% year to date; tanker indices 25–30% off October peaks
items.summary: BIMCO's November outlook puts year-to-date crude and dirty-product volumes 5% below last year and clean-product volumes 11% lower. Middle East tanker exports reached 75% of pre-war levels over the past four weeks, while Russian clean-product exports have averaged 58% below last year since the start of Q3 after Ukrainian refinery strikes. The Platts global dirty and clean tanker indices are 25–30% below their October highs; BIMCO sets out 'Hormuz open' and 'Hormuz closed' scenarios for 2027–28 without numeric forecasts.

items.title: Med Emre update: no pollution reported so far after chemical tanker capsized off Ibiza
items.summary: The Malta-flagged, 2019-built 8,270 dwt chemical tanker capsized and sank off Ibiza with about 7,000 t of diesel aboard; one crew member died. gCaptain reports no pollution detected so far. The cause has not been reported.

items.title: Hafnia defers decision on its $687m stake in Torm
items.summary: Hafnia has postponed a decision on what to do with its Torm shareholding, valued at about $687m, according to Splash. Torm previously rejected Hafnia's all-share merger proposals, and Hafnia had said with its Q3 results that it planned to distribute Torm shares as an extraordinary dividend; no new timetable was given in the headline report.

items.title: BIMCO issues tanker clause putting STS transfer costs and risks on charterers
items.summary: BIMCO has published a standard clause for tanker charter parties covering ship-to-ship transfers and special operations. It assigns the related costs and risks to charterers while preserving the master's authority over vessel safety.

items.title: Kpler: 44m bbl of Iranian oil afloat on 37 tankers under US blockade
items.summary: Kpler counts about 44m bbl of Iranian crude and condensate on 37 tankers (16 VLCCs, 12 suezmaxes, 6 aframaxes, 3 MRs) and no Iranian export loadings since Aug 24. It found an AIS identity spoofing the chemical tanker STOLT BOBCAT (IMO 9511167) and counted five STS transfers of about 1.9m bbl on Nov 12–18.

items.title: EU proposes ban on Russian-insured tankers in 22nd sanctions package
items.summary: The European Commission's draft 22nd package would bar tankers insured in Russia from EU services and restrict repair services at Russian refineries.

items.title: Kpler: Hormuz flows at 55% of pre-war level in week to Nov 25; Splash counts 17 tanker strikes this month
items.summary: Kpler data cited by CNN/CTV put Strait of Hormuz flows at 55% of pre-war levels in the week to Nov 25, with around two dozen Iranian attacks on tankers in the strait during November. Splash247 separately tallies 17 tanker strikes in Hormuz so far this month (headline figure; article not reviewed).

items.title: US forces disable Palau-flagged Pacific Archer in Gulf of Oman over blockade run
items.summary: The US military said it disabled the M/V Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman on Nov 26 after the ship left Bandar Abbas and its crew tried to run the US blockade of Iran. Precision munitions struck the stern; CENTCOM said propulsion was disabled and the civilian crew was unharmed.

items.title: Jazan refinery strike kills one worker; coalition says it hit 50 Houthi targets
items.summary: A strike on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery on Nov 26 killed a Nepali worker, injured others and caused a fire and temporary shutdown of some operations, according to the Saudi energy ministry; the Saudi-led coalition blamed the Houthis. The coalition said it then destroyed 50 targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah and Saada, including the launcher used in the attack.

items.title: Abu Dhabi restricts tanker movements over Gulf security
items.summary: Abu Dhabi authorities have placed restrictions on tanker movements in response to rising security risks in Gulf waters. ADNOC also confirmed that a Jordanian crew member missing since the Nov 17 attack on an ADNOC L&S vessel in Hormuz was found dead; two of 11 injured crew remain in care.

items.title: UNCTAD: seaborne trade flat in 2026; IMO confirms 141 attacks in Hormuz region
items.summary: UNCTAD's Review of Maritime Transport 2026 says global maritime trade stalled this year after 1.9% growth in 2025 to 12.3bn tonnes. The IMO has confirmed 141 attacks across Hormuz and the wider Middle East as of Nov 23, with 25 seafarer deaths; late-November Hormuz traffic averaged about 4–28 ships a day against 85–140 before the war. UKMTO logged about 22 incidents in November, 10 involving tankers.

items.title: Containership sinks off Cuba; one seafarer dead, three missing
items.summary: Splash247 reports a boxship sank off Cuba, leaving one crew member dead and three missing. Vessel details and cause were not available in the listing reviewed.

items.title: Lower Mississippi at New Orleans: Coast Guard safety zone remains through Dec 11
items.summary: The Coast Guard's safety zone for the salvage of a river cruise ship after its collision with a tanker near New Orleans remains in place through Dec 11, with traffic restrictions on that stretch of the river.

items.title: Close Fri Nov 27 (half day): S&P 500 7,297.49 (+1.60%), Dow 50,774.94 (+1.18%), Nasdaq 24,129.50 (+2.31%)
items.summary: In the shortened Black Friday session the S&P 500 rose 114.71 points, the Dow 591.99 and the Nasdaq Composite 543.70, as chip and AI-related shares recovered from earlier November losses; the PHLX Semiconductor index gained 4.69% and all 11 S&P sectors rose. From the Nov 20 close the S&P 500 is up 5.60% on the week, though it remains down about 3.7% for November.

items.title: Oil: Brent $97.71 (+1.2%) and WTI $86.27 (+3.1% vs Wednesday) early Friday ahead of Sunday OPEC+ meeting
items.summary: At 07:45 GMT on Nov 27, January Brent was $97.71, up $1.14, after Thursday's settle was its highest since Nov 6; WTI, which had no Thursday settlement, was $86.27, up $2.59 from Wednesday. Later Friday Brent was around $96 and WTI around $84.50 (CTV). Refinery disruptions in Saudi Arabia, Russia, Thailand and Venezuela were cited; sources expect OPEC+ to keep targets unchanged for at least Q1 2027. Friday settlement prices were not yet available.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield up 8.8 bp at 4.936% Friday; Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%
items.summary: The 10-year yield was at 4.936% on Friday, up 8.8 basis points, ahead of the bond market's 2 pm ET early close (Kiplinger). Yahoo Finance reported Q3 GDP growth revised up to 4.3% from 3.4%. CME FedWatch showed traders favouring a December rate increase, with next week's jobs report in focus.

items.title: Gold up 3.0% to $3,672.70; copper futures +3.3%; bitcoin −0.95%
items.summary: Gold futures rose $108.10 (3.03%) to $3,672.70 an ounce on Nov 27 and front-month copper gained 3.3% after rising as much as 6.5% Thursday. Bitcoin was at $59,825.79, down 0.95%.

items.title: Asia Friday: Shanghai +3.73%, Hang Seng +2.11%, Nikkei +2.11% after Beijing support pledge
items.summary: Chinese shares rallied after state media said the government would take further steps to counter the market decline; the Shenzhen Component rose 6.3%. Japan's Topix gained 1.7%, with memory-chip makers among the leaders.

items.title: Europe closed higher Thursday: Stoxx 600 +1.7%, DAX 25,215 (+2.1%), FTSE 100 10,609 (+1.8%)
items.summary: European shares rose on Nov 26, led by chipmakers ASML (+3.2%), Infineon (+4.0%) and STMicro (+4.3%); the CAC 40 gained 1.6% to 8,109 and Volkswagen led the DAX with +4.6%. UK and German 10-year yields rose 2 bp each.

items.title: Corporate: Tesla +5.2% amid reported SpaceX merger talks; SAP plans at least 10,000 job cuts
items.summary: Tesla rose 5.2% to $400.00 on Nov 27 after the FT reported board committees of Tesla and SpaceX are discussing an all-stock combination, though the sides are said not to be close to agreement. Bloomberg reports SAP is preparing to cut at least 10,000 positions.

items.title: Drone attack in Kuwait kills two Italian technicians; Iran denies role and offers joint probe
items.summary: A drone struck an air-defence system in Kuwait, injuring four people; two Italians working for Rheinmetall Italia later died. Iran's military denied involvement and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi offered a joint investigation with Kuwait and Italy. Saudi Arabia and the UK condemned the attack, and EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called for more pressure on Iran.

items.title: Trump says 'victory at hand' in Iran war during Thanksgiving call
items.summary: Speaking from Mar-a-Lago on Nov 26, President Trump said the US has victory at hand in the war with Iran and that the timing of its end is his decision. He played down reports of Russian and Chinese intelligence sharing with Tehran.

items.title: IRGC commander warns of action 'in the air and at sea'
items.summary: Majid Mousavi, commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force, said on X on Nov 27 that Iran's enemies should expect action in the air and at sea. The statement followed the US disabling of a ship attempting to run the blockade in the Gulf of Oman.

items.title: Russian strikes kill 6 in Ukraine; power cut in six regions
items.summary: Russian attacks over the past day killed six people and injured 25, and substation strikes left parts of six oblasts temporarily without power, with Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson hardest hit. Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 155 drones overnight, 110 of which were downed or suppressed.

items.title: EU budget summit ends without agreement
items.summary: An EU leaders' summit on the bloc's budget broke up without a deal on Nov 27, with leaders holding to their positions, Euronews reports. Spain holds a general election on Sunday, Nov 29.

items.title: German Bundestag approves record 2027 budget with €210bn of borrowing
items.summary: Germany's parliament passed the 2027 federal budget on Nov 27, with new borrowing of €210bn, according to Euronews.

items.title: Israel: Eisenkot says Likud is stalling coalition talks; Dec 6 deadline
items.summary: Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a government after October's inconclusive election, accused Netanyahu's Likud of stalling. His Yashar party has agreements with the Democrats and Yisrael Beiteinu totalling 36 seats, short of the 61 needed; his deadline is Dec 6, extendable by 14 days.

items.title: Broncos (8–2) at Steelers (6–4) today, Nov 27, 2:00 pm CT on Prime Video
items.summary: Denver goes for a seventh straight win at Pittsburgh, which is 4–0 at home. The team has ruled out S Taylor Rapp (quad) and DL Sai'vion Jones (hamstring), who did not travel; S Brandon Jones, WR Pat Bryant, S JL Skinner, RB Tyler Badie and TE Caleb Lohner practiced fully.

items.title: Texans (4–6) host Ravens (4–7) Sunday at noon CT on CBS; Hunter missed practice
items.summary: On Thursday's practice report, DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), WR Kayshon Boutte (hip), TE Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) and C/G Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) did not practice; WR Marvin Harrison Jr. was a full participant. For Baltimore, RB Derrick Henry (concussion) practiced fully Thursday and DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) did not practice. Game-status designations had not yet been issued.

items.title: Davis Cup semifinal: Musetti beats Mensik 6-3, 6-4; Italy leads Czechia 1–0
items.summary: In Bologna on Nov 27, Lorenzo Musetti defeated Jakub Mensik 6-3, 6-4 in 1 hour 26 minutes, saving all six break points. Flavio Cobolli plays Jiri Lehecka next, with doubles if needed; the tie result was not yet available.

items.title: Davis Cup: Spain beats Austria 2–0 without Alcaraz; meets Britain Saturday
items.summary: Merida beat Schwaerzler 6-4, 6-4 and Jodar beat Rodionov 2-6, 6-0, 6-1 on Nov 26. Spain plays Great Britain in the second semifinal Saturday, Nov 28 at 12 pm CET (5 am CT); the final is Sunday, Nov 29 at 3 pm CET (8 am CT).

items.title: Davis Cup: Britain beats Germany 2–1 to reach first semifinal in seven years
items.summary: Cameron Norrie beat Jan-Lennard Struff 6-3, 3-6, 6-2 and Henry Patten/Neal Skupski won the deciding doubles 6-2, 7-6(6) over Kevin Krawietz/Tim Puetz in Bologna on Nov 26. Britain faces the Austria–Spain winner in the semifinals.
